message.content: Based on the conversations provided in the data, there is no specific mention of Li Hua suggesting a particular schedule for the water pipe repairs. However, Li Hua did express her willingness to keep an eye on the issue and inform Adam Smith if she noticed anything unusual. Adam Smith assured Li Hua that he would keep her updated once he had a repair schedule. Therefore, it appears that the responsibility for determining the exact timing of the repairs was left to Adam Smith.
